source: spec-less probe fallback (edge-probe.cjs over SYNC-01..05, CAL-01..04, SEC-02), resolved by the orchestrator 2026-11-05 (owner rule: orchestrator approves process gates); revised 2026-11-05 during plan revision 1: the six formerly unclassified items were reclassified into taxonomy categories and every item names its proving test(s) and plan

items.resolution: The visible range is half-open [start, end): a meeting ending exactly at range start or starting exactly at range end is not returned for that range; one overlapping the boundary is returned.

GET /m365/meetings for a range with no cached meetings returns an empty list with status, sends no HTTP request to Graph (Http::assertNothingSent), and the calendar shows the 'No Outlook meetings in this range' status copy.
Meetings are returned ordered by start ASC, then end ASC, then occurrence id ASC (stable across calls).
Two sync requests for the same user and week bucket inside the 60 s reuse window cause exactly one Graph calendarView traversal.
A sync request from a user with no Microsoft account (or after Disconnect) sends no Graph request and returns status not_connected.
With one sync in flight, rapid navigation queues only the latest desired week bucket; intermediate buckets are never synced (Vitest fake timers).
tests: resources/js/m365/calendar/useOutlookMeetings.test.ts: 'queues only the latest bucket while a sync is in flight'

items.resolution: Back-to-back meetings (A ends 10:00, B starts 10:00) are both stored and rendered as two separate ghosts.
A calendarView page with zero events but an @odata.nextLink is followed; traversal stops only when nextLink is absent (or the configurable page cap is hit, which counts as partial).
Overlapping ghosts are assigned lanes deterministically by start, then end, then occurrence id; lanes capped at 3 per UI-SPEC.
tests: resources/js/m365/calendar/ghostLayout.test.ts: 'assigns lanes by start, end, id capped at 3'

items.resolution: Fixture S2 occurrences are stored as 08:00Z (2026-10-20) and 09:00Z (2026-10-27), emitted with a Z suffix, and both render at 10:00 for a user with timezone Europe/Madrid; Graph's 7-digit fractional seconds parse correctly.
items.reason: time representation: naive seven-digit UTC strings in, Z-suffixed UTC out, wall-clock conversion in the browser
tests: resources/js/m365/calendar/ghostLayout.test.ts: 'S2 occurrences render at 10:00 Europe/Madrid across DST'

items.resolution: A Graph 'no mailbox' answer yields an empty meeting list and the quiet status 'No Outlook calendar for this account', never an error.
Retry-After is read as integer seconds clamped to 1..300; a missing, HTTP-date or unparseable value falls back to 30 s.
While graph_backoff_until is in the future, further sync requests make no Graph call and return cached meetings with status throttled and the retry time.
A traversal interrupted by timeout, 5xx or page cap never marks any cached meeting as gone; concurrent syncs for one user are serialized by a per-user lock and the second reuses the first result.
Day and week totals computed with ghosts present equal totals without ghosts, and a sync never changes the time_entries row count.
items.reason: applying the overlay or re-running a sync must leave totals, rows and reports unchanged
tests: resources/js/m365/calendar/OutlookGhostLayer.test.ts: 'day and week totals are unchanged when ghosts are injected'
e2e/outlook-ghosts.spec.ts: 'ghosts render from injected meetings and leave entries and totals unchanged'

items.resolution: A pointerdown on a ghost does not start a slot selection while a pointerdown on empty grid does (control); ghost DOM carries no .fc-event, [data-event-id], .fc-timegrid-col or .fc-event-resizer.
items.reason: ghosts sit next to entries and empty grid; the collision of pointer targets is the edge
tests: resources/js/m365/calendar/OutlookGhostLayer.test.ts: 'pointerdown on a ghost starts no selection'
resources/js/m365/calendar/OutlookGhostLayer.test.ts: 'a ghost exactly overlapping an entry stays rendered and clickable beside it'
e2e/outlook-ghosts.spec.ts: 'a ghost exactly overlapping a time entry stays visible and clickable and the entry stays editable'

items.resolution: Meeting endpoints return only the authenticated user's rows for member, manager and owner roles; dismissing another user's meeting id returns 404; while impersonating, endpoints return no meetings and send no Graph request (D-22).
items.reason: ownership boundary between users and the impersonation edge of that boundary

items.resolution: Dismiss and restore are idempotent, a dismissal survives a re-sync that returns the same occurrence, and include_dismissed toggles visibility.
items.reason: repeated dismiss/restore and re-sync on the same occurrence

items.resolution: An expired access token is refreshed once under a row lock and the rotated refresh token is stored encrypted; invalid_grant/interaction_required/consent_required set reconnect_required and clear tokens; invalid_client/unauthorized_client map to unavailable and keep tokens; 5xx/timeout are transient.
items.reason: refresh races on one token row plus the effect ordering of failure classification
